tasks.goal: Patrol the Operations Deck atop the Hoover Dam Powerhouse, visually inspecting gauges and panel readouts along the parapet walkway.
tasks.terrain: Concrete crest walkway with 331.4 m of relief around it; intake tower and cableway tower guy-points as fixed obstacles; occasional tourist crowds on the road.
success: Covers 6 predefined waypoint poses within 0.2 m tolerance
Publishes >=20 readable gauge crops with confidence >0.8
safety_stops: E-stop on proximity <1.0 m to humans
Stop if edge detection shows walkway drop-off <0.5 m ahead
Halt on gauge anomaly for human review
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward reviews any flagged gauge anomaly before an incident ticket is opened.

tasks.goal: Small-dog robot carries registry checklist tablets along indoor desks in the Exhibit Building and Visitor Center corridors.
tasks.terrain: Polished indoor visitor-center floors, door thresholds, exhibit plinths and cabling at floor level.
success: Map localization drift <0.3 m over route
tasks.human_in_loop: Person confirms each desk station is the correct registry point before log entry.

tasks.goal: Biped rehearses turning large hand-wheel valves at the Arizona Valve House as a dry-run provisioning choreography, no live flow changes.
tasks.terrain: Valve house floor is grating over the Colorado River outflow; overhead pipes limit standing height; wheel rims are wet metal.
success: Grasps wheel within 2 cm of target pose
Completes 3 full rehearsal rotations at <=15 Nm torque
Releases and steps back on command
safety_stops: Abort on unexpected pipe pressure noise signature
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves before any valve interaction, even in rehearsal; real flow changes are human-only.

tasks.goal: Arm rehearses pick-and-place of mock cableway payloads staged near the Cableway Power House, simulating release/rollback of loadouts.
tasks.terrain: Stationary mount on powerhouse apron; mock payloads on concrete pad; wind gusts off Lake Mead affect light items.
success: Rollback slot executes within 5 s of fault injection
safety_stops: Speed limit 250 mm/s when humans within 2.5 m
tasks.human_in_loop: Person approves each rollback drill trigger and inspects any dropped-payload event.

tasks.goal: Survey access roads from the Visitor Center to the Nevada Spillway to build a terrain plan for future infrastructure runs.
tasks.terrain: 125 mapped road segments, desert sand and gravel switchbacks descending toward the spillway, 331.4 m relief; loose rock near Arizona Spillway channel.
success: Completes 1.5 km route, localization error <1 m
Slope estimates within 3 degrees of IMU ground truth
No rollover events on >20 degree grades
safety_stops: Slow to 0.5 m/s on grade >15 degrees
Stop near spillway channel edge <2 m
tasks.human_in_loop: Steward approves the route plan and any descent below the spillway rim.

tasks.goal: Micro-UAV flies indoor calibration scans around service racks set up in the Exhibit Building, mapping cable wiring layout for configuration review.
tasks.terrain: Indoor hall with exhibit trusses overhead, glass display cases as no-fly buffers, HVAC drafts near doorways.
success: Position hold within 10 cm in draft
tasks.human_in_loop: Person reviews the generated cable layout map before it enters configuration records.

tasks.goal: Fetch mobile manipulator checks relief and monitoring stations inside the Hoover Dam Powerhouse hall, reading status panels while stewards stay on the deck above.
tasks.terrain: Powerhouse hall: tiled floor, turbine gallery railings, overhead crane rails, standing water film near Colorado River intakes.
success: Log streamed to deck console in real time
safety_stops: No-go on wet-floor zones flagged by slip sensor
tasks.human_in_loop: Steward on the deck receives readings and approves escalation of any anomaly.
